competition: 2026青年AI音乐嘉年华·单曲组·提报口径：成长经历×青春理想（毕业前的迷茫与选择）

target.key_strategy: G major overall, E minor-flavored bridge, final chorus modulates up a whole step to A major
target.vocal_range: female lead A3-C5; final chorus peaks B4 with choir support; male fallback down 3-4 semitones

lead_voice.timbre: warm, plainspoken young female lead, no grit, no scream
lead_voice.narrative_role: first-person student at the fork of graduation; intro/outro sung softly like talking to himself; bridge confessional

hook.strategy: sentence-level repetition only: hook pair (lines 1,3) verbatim; chorus 2 upgrades all content lines (黑的地方也有路口/每一步都不会白走/天快亮的时候抬头/未来在下一个路口); final chorus upgrades again (先走的人先拥有/跟你挥手) with whole-step lift; no whole-section verbatim repeats (L8)
